# Expandable Search

A search that rests as an icon button and grows into a full field on click. One box widens under the magnifier, so the glyph never moves and the open field is the DS Input, pixel for pixel.

```tsx
<div className="flex items-center gap-2">
  <p className="text-sm font-medium">All files</p>
  <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">128</span>
  <div className="flex-1" />
  <ExpandableSearch size="md" placeholder="Search files" className="w-56" />
  <Button variant="outline">Export</Button>
  <Button>Upload</Button>
</div>
```

## Installation

```bash
# One-time setup (tokens + lib helpers)
npx koalaui-cli@latest init

# Add this component (its dependencies come along)
npx koalaui-cli@latest add expandable-search
```

Manual: run `npm install radix-ui tailwind-variants tailwind-merge`, then copy the source into `components/ui/expandable-search/` and adjust the import paths to your project. Components pull `cn` from `lib/utils`, the `tv` wrapper from `lib/tv`, and (for multi-part components) `createContext` from `lib/create-context`.

## Usage

```tsx title="usage.tsx"
import { ExpandableSearch } from "@/components/ui/expandable-search"

export function Example() {
  return (
    <ExpandableSearch
      placeholder="Search files"
      className="w-64" // the OPEN width
      inputProps={{ onChange: (e) => setQuery(e.target.value) }}
    />
  )
}
```

## How it opens and closes

A click opens it and puts the caret in the field. Escape steps back one layer at a time: the first press clears the query, the second folds the search away and hands focus back to the button. Clicking elsewhere folds an empty search, but one that holds a query stays open, so the text filtering the page never disappears behind an icon. The width transition names its properties and switches off under reduced motion.

## Sizes

The Input's own axis: `sm` 32px, `md` 36px, `lg` 40px. At rest it is a square of that height, the same size as a ghost icon Button beside it; unset, it follows the container's imposed size or the density.

```tsx
<ExpandableSearch size="sm" />
<ExpandableSearch size="md" />
<ExpandableSearch size="lg" />
```

## With a shortcut

Trailing content rides inside the open field, like a `Kbd` hint. Control `open` when something outside the component opens it: press `/` anywhere on this page.

```tsx
const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
const field = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null)

// "/" opens it from anywhere on the page, except while typing in a field.
useEffect(() => {
  const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
    if (e.key !== "/" || e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.altKey) return
    if ((e.target as HTMLElement).closest("input, textarea, select, [contenteditable=true]")) return
    e.preventDefault()
    setOpen(true)
  }
  window.addEventListener("keydown", onKey)
  return () => window.removeEventListener("keydown", onKey)
}, [])

// Opened from outside, so the caller hands focus to the field once it is live.
useEffect(() => { if (open) field.current?.focus() }, [open])

<ExpandableSearch
  open={open}
  onOpenChange={setOpen}
  placeholder="Search anything"
  className="w-72"
  inputProps={{ ref: field }}
>
  <InputSuffix><Kbd size="sm">/</Kbd></InputSuffix>
</ExpandableSearch>
```

## States

At rest, open with a query, and disabled. It is an `InputRoot` underneath, so `hasError`, a surrounding `Field` and the focus ring all behave exactly as they do on an Input.

```tsx
<ExpandableSearch />
<ExpandableSearch defaultOpen className="w-56" inputProps={{ defaultValue: "Quarterly report" }} />
<ExpandableSearch disabled />
```

## In a navbar

[`NavbarSearch collapsible`](https://www.koalaui.com/docs/components/navbar.md#search) is this component tuned for the bar: 36px and `rounded-md` at rest, the hamburger's chip, so it reads as one of the bar's icons until someone searches.

```tsx
<Navbar linkStyle="text">
  <NavbarInner>
    <NavbarBrand href="/"><BrandMark /></NavbarBrand>
    <NavbarNav className="ml-2">…</NavbarNav>
    <NavbarSpacer />
    <NavbarSearch collapsible placeholder="Search docs" />
    <NavbarActions>…</NavbarActions>
  </NavbarInner>
</Navbar>
```

## API reference

### ExpandableSearch

An `InputRoot` whose leading magnifier is the button that opens it. Forwards `InputRoot` props (`hasError`, `disabled`, `density`…).

- `open` / `defaultOpen` / `onOpenChange`: the expanded state. Focus moves only for the component's own button, never for `defaultOpen` or a controlled change.
- `size`: `"sm"`, `"md"` or `"lg"`. The closed square and the open field's height.
- `className`: merged onto the box; a width class (`w-80`) sets the OPEN width, default `w-64`. The closed width is pinned by the size, so it never fights yours.
- `placeholder`: default `"Search"`. `label` overrides the accessible name the button and the field share (defaults to the placeholder).
- `inputProps`: forwarded to the `<input type="search">` (`value`, `onChange`, `name`, `ref`…). Escape clears a controlled value through its own `onChange`.
- `children`: trailing content inside the open field, such as `InputSuffix` with a `Kbd`.

## FAQ

### When should I use ExpandableSearch instead of a plain search Input?

When the row can't spare a field's width until someone actually searches: a table toolbar, a dense app header, a marketing navbar with a full link set. Where search is the main way around the product, keep the always-open field (an `Input` with an `InputPrefix`, or `NavbarSearch`) so nobody has to find it first.

### How do I set how wide it opens?

Give it a width class: `className="w-80"`. That class only applies while it is open; the closed width is pinned by `size` (a 32, 36 or 40px square), so the two never fight. Default open width is `w-64`.

### Why doesn't it close when I click away?

It does, unless the field holds a query. Folding a live search behind an icon would hide the very text that is filtering the page. Press Escape to clear the query, and Escape again to close it.

### How do I open it with a keyboard shortcut?

Control `open`: set it to true from your shortcut handler (`/` or ⌘K), and focus the field (through `inputProps.ref`) once it is open. The component moves focus only when its own button opens it, so a search that mounts open or opens from outside never steals the page's focus on its own.

### Is it accessible?

At rest it is a labelled button with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` pointing at the field; the closed field is `inert`, out of the tab order and the accessibility tree. Open, the magnifier drops out of the tab order and the `type="search"` field carries the same accessible name.

## Exports and dependencies

`npx koalaui-cli@latest add expandable-search` writes `components/ui/expandable-search/`. Import from `@/components/ui/expandable-search`:

- Components and helpers: `ExpandableSearch`, `expandableSearchVariants`
- Types: `ExpandableSearchProps`
- Koala components it installs with it: `input`
- Koala lib helpers it uses: `density`, `hit-area`, `tv`
- npm packages: `@phosphor-icons/react`
